facts.fact: 宿醉次日遛狗散步：冰淇淋、拍照、互诉「再也不来了」；她意识到 Perla 买的是「像买那条酒红裙一样的男人」。
facts.anchor: He leaned down, whispering in her ear. “I long to kiss you.”

facts.fact: 舞池勒索开场：Cándido 钳住她共舞低语——他目击巷中野合；侦探在 Beto 处留了卡片，他打电话确认过「死胡同」。
facts.anchor: “I saw you in the alleyway with Ulises last night.”

facts.fact: 他拼出真相：Linares=侦探要找的骗子；花花公子用的杂志《Conmovedor》与姨妈爱读的是同一份。
facts.anchor: “I can put two and two together, you viper. Linares is the man the detective is looking for.

facts.fact: 勒索条款：滚出小镇+两万比索「婚礼贺礼」；离镇几个月后让婚姻作废——Perla 会因羞耻主动回头嫁他。
facts.anchor: “I want that lying asshole out of this town, and I want him out forever.

facts.fact: 死线：周一交钱周一走人，否则找侦探+告诉姨妈；「不然我早一枪崩了他」。
facts.anchor: “I want that money by Monday, and I want him gone that same day.

facts.fact: 抵押=肉体：手从背后下滑挑明意图；她提议「明晚你开车来接我，出镇上山停车」——引蛇出洞。
facts.anchor: “Then you’ll have to come up with collateral. To keep me nice and quiet.”

facts.fact: 他在车里放话「敢耍我：正中眉心」；她不需要假装害怕。
facts.anchor: And if you should even think of cheating me: Right between the eyes, my girl. Right between the eyes.”

facts.fact: 深夜客厅定策：她主张杀、他主张逃；她列清利害——他报警、告诉姨妈、我们都完蛋，他有枪。
计划定稿：hip flask 下安眠药（floripondio 曼陀罗煮茶）→魔鬼椅坠崖伪造车祸；她不会开车，他负责驾。
facts.anchor: “We can throw him off the Devil’s Chair,” she continued, the idea becoming more vivid and firm in her mind. “They’d never be able to retrieve the vehicle from there.

facts.fact: 等待中的争吵变调情：她指甲掐进他手臂；分尸般的客厅性爱（Monsignor 路易斯·曼努埃尔的沙发）。
facts.anchor: “You have the claws of a tiger.”

facts.fact: 周日夜执行：他躲在 Galindo 大宅墙边；她上车先「祷告」再递壶；他嫌「这酒真糟」灌下大半——她用石块砸他后脑（gurgle 声）。
facts.anchor: “I boiled floripondio. If you have too much of it, it can kill. And then I hit him with a rock as you suggested.”

facts.fact: 坠崖准备时 Cándido 复活反扑，扼住 Ulises 脖子；她补石两下无效，Ulises 夺石朝脸砸「两、三、四下」至死。
facts.anchor: Suddenly the dead man opened his eyes and gasped, clutching Ulises.

facts.fact: 他来回踱步重复「我们真的干了」，蹲在车边呕吐、满手是血；她镇定指挥「把他抬上车」。
facts.anchor: “My God. We really did it,” Ulises whispered.

facts.fact: 意外：车翻滚六七米卡在窄岩架，双轮悬空打转——没滚进谷底；开始下雨，两人冒雨步行四十分钟回镇，她梦见的是母亲而非 Cándido；清晨醒来确认「我们是杀人犯了」。
facts.anchor: It had tumbled a good six or eight meters, then wedged itself atop a narrow ledge, two wheels spinning in the air.
